claim: On April 29, 2005, the original Bugatti Veyron 16.4 became the first series-production car to exceed 400 km/h, reaching 407 km/h at Volkswagen's Ehra-Lessien test track, driven by test driver Uwe Novacki.
notes: Confirmed via Bugatti's own official press-release archive (primary source).

claim: On July 3, 2010, the Bugatti Veyron 16.4 Super Sport set a new production-car land speed record of 431.072 km/h (267.856 mph), driven by test driver Pierre-Henri Raphanel at the Ehra-Lessien track, witnessed by TUV officials and a Guinness World Records adjudicator.
notes: Confirmed via Bugatti's own official press-release archive (primary source).

claim: In April 2013, Guinness World Records briefly stripped the Veyron Super Sport of its 'world's fastest production car' title because the record-setting car had its speed limiter disabled beyond the specification sold to customers, then reinstated the record shortly afterward.
notes: Reported contemporaneously by a reputable automotive trade outlet; corroborated by additional coverage found during research.

claim: On November 4, 2017, the Koenigsegg Agera RS recorded a two-way average speed of 447 km/h (277.9 mph) near Pahrump, Nevada -- independently verified by Racelogic -- ending the Bugatti Veyron Super Sport's run as the world's fastest verified production car.
notes: Corroborated by multiple contemporaneous outlets found during research (CTV News, Top Gear, dupontregistry).

claim: The Veyron Super Sport's quad-turbocharged 8.0-liter W16 engine produces 1,200 PS (1,200 hp) and 1,106 lb-ft of torque, with a 0-100 km/h time of 2.5 seconds; customer cars are electronically limited to 415 km/h.
notes: Figures are consistent across several secondary/aggregator sources (Borro, Netcarshow, Zeperfs) but were not cross-checked against Bugatti's own official spec sheet during this research pass -- flagging for J to confirm against a primary Bugatti source before publishing.

claim: Bugatti built only 48 Veyron Super Sport units (2010-2011), out of roughly 450 Veyron-family cars produced in total across all variants over the model's decade-long production run.
notes: Production totals are reported consistently by secondary sources but were not independently cross-verified against a Bugatti factory production ledger during this research pass -- flagging for J to confirm before publishing.
